coverage.reason: Approved art and interactive reference: 32 transparent poses, eight and reversed directions, upright troop information, responsive layouts and motion preferences. Production integration is tested separately. Readiness polling tolerates the brief missing document element after navigation, exposed by the Linux CI runner.

Shared client/server catalog replaces troop placeholder metadata and references the approved atlas at the existing price. Validate authoritative ownership, price, revisions, idempotency, separate purchase/equip, public appearance permissions and default switching.

Integrate approved art through existing troop and cosmetic renderers. Validate eight headings and recalled/cross-map segments without changing positions or timing; purchase/selection/Apply/Default and own/remote/leader/scout appearance; count privacy, route controls, stable nodes, failure fallback, decoded art and 6/8 motion caps. Shared motion changes require city/preview regression checks. Desktop/mobile stress reports compare full-map and isolated decoration costs. Production build, entry/cache smoke and budgets check module/resource packaging, the compiled atlas provenance hash and lazy loading. Master Specification records only the approved troop design; no gameplay, price or deployed-state change. March performance changes require bounded display-error and DOM-write checks across zoom/DPR, fast/Swift/return routes, region transitions, pending-snapshot blending and covered-map catch-up. The optional baseline comparator records controlled CPU/frame measurements; it is not a physical-device guarantee.

The mandatory entry smoke exposed an existing Rally fixture mismatch with the October 1 Master Specification and unchanged main renderer: its leader was missing from participants and it incorrectly rejected all inbound contributions. Supply the creator and assert the established Ready minimum, creator readiness, and early launch with additional inbound troops in both card views. No Rally runtime or gameplay rules changed.
